R1.summary: bash quickstart must fail fast and activate portably (POSIX + Windows)

acceptance.detail: new class QuickstartBashFailFast asserts: first line starts with `set -e`; a line falls back to `.venv/Scripts/activate` via `||`; no bare POSIX-only activate line

acceptance.command: bash -x quickstart.sh (extracted programmatically; pinned interpreter with pip-less venv)
acceptance.detail: block aborts at `python -m venv`; no step after it runs; NO global install
`. .venv/bin/activate` exit 1 -> `|| . .venv/Scripts/activate` fires -> pip install lands in .venv (pip show Location = .venv\Lib\site-packages; sys.path includes .venv)

acceptance.command: importlib.util.find_spec('pipd_ls_sp') in global interpreters; rm scratch venvs
acceptance.detail: no global site-packages residue (spec None in both interpreters); both scratch venvs removed

R2.summary: self-bootstrap README must state determinism only for identical rooted inputs

acceptance.detail: test_replay_is_root_bound_not_root_independent: same root -> identical PI/PD/ECP/TQAEP+bundle; different roots -> PI/TQAEP identical, PD/ECP/bundle differ
two same-root runs IDENTICAL (bundle_digest 436a1e7e6a56fb9c); committed digests.json recomputes to its own bundle_digest (CONSISTENT, not stale) -> NOT regenerated

observations: set -e plus the `||` fallback make the block either complete in the venv or abort; the pinned interpreter's pip-less venv makes the fail-fast demonstrable.
run_selfbootstrap.py unconditionally rewrites digests.json AND negative_stale_context.txt on every positive run; negative_stale_context.txt is out of write scope and was restored to HEAD.
The committed digests.json records schema_source.path with a duplicated drive-letter segment (C:\c\Users\...); cosmetic in the echo, no digest effect; reported, not repaired.
